=Release Tutorial=
This tutorial describes how to release plugins.

Step 1:
Open the plugin's plugin.xml file. It should have a version number ending with ".qualifier":

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/dfb0a.png]

Change this old version number to the new one (e.g. 0.1.0) *without* a ".qualifier" ending:

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/a531d.png]

Note: if you want to release all plugins, you can use search and replace. 

Step 2:

Commit the version change:

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/60c2b.png]

Step 3:

Create a tag for the release:

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/1b723.png]

Configure the tag according to the release version number, e.g. in this case set the "To URL" to:https://wwwbruegge.in.tum.de/repos/unicase/tags/org.unicase.ui.navigator/0.1.0/org.unicase.ui.navigator(replace org.unicase.ui.navigator with the plugin you are working with and 0.1.0 with your version).

If you release all plugins, use unicase/tags/X.X.X

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/2afc4.png]
